name: symphony-walkman
description: Pedestrian-signal board for Claude Code and Claude Desktop: the green walking man marks the Jira card Claude is working on, the red man marks a card waiting for you.

runs_dir.title: symphony-workflow runs folder
runs_dir.description: Optional. Folder holding <KEY>/run.json written by symphony-workflow (its docs/runs). Lets a card in plan_ready light the red man. Read only.

jira_project.title: Jira project key (optional)
jira_project.description: For example JEV. With the setting below, the board shows card titles and the project's in-progress cards. Read only.

jira_base_url.title: Jira site URL (optional)
jira_base_url.description: For example https://your-site.atlassian.net. With the email and token below, the board's Jira lookup needs no credentials file.

jira_email.title: Jira account email (optional)
jira_email.description: The email of the Atlassian account that owns the API token.

jira_api_token.title: Jira API token (optional)
jira_api_token.description: Create one at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Kept in Claude Code's secure storage and handed only to the read-only Jira lookup, as an environment variable, never on a command line.

jira_env_file.title: Jira credentials file (optional)
jira_env_file.description: A .env with JIRA_BASE_URL, JIRA_EMAIL and JIRA_API_TOKEN. Default: ~/.config/symphony-workflow/.env. The Jira lookup runs the released symphony-workflow through uvx with it, so no clone is needed.

symphony_workflow_dir.title: symphony-workflow checkout (optional)
symphony_workflow_dir.description: Only if you run symphony-workflow from a clone: its folder (holds the .env). Leave empty to use the released CLI through uvx.

disk_path.title: Disk to watch
disk_path.description: Path whose free space the board shows.
